_: Spell tomes + skill books — books that DO something when read. The killer combo: a FULLY CUSTOM spell (custom MGEF + custom SPEL) bundled with a spell TOME that teaches it (MGEF->SPEL->BOOK.Teaches=spell, all in one spec). Reading the tome grants the custom spell. Plus a vanilla-spell tome, and a skill book that raises a Skill on read. Book.Teaches discovered via `bookdiag` against vanilla SpellTomeIncinerate (0x10F7F4, teaches Spell) and SkillSmithing5 (0x01AFD2, teaches Skill=Smithing). GOTCHA: a takeable/readable book STILL needs a `template` (a vanilla book to clone a model .nif from) or it CRASHES on 3D-read — so every tome clones a vanilla SpellTome.

magicEffects.name: Ember Lance
magicEffects.description: A lance of embers that sears the target.
magicEffects._: Mirrors a vanilla fire Aimed damage effect (ValueModifier/Health, Destruction, ResistFire, FireAndForget/Aimed, Hostile+Detrimental+NoArea, low baseCost for sane autocalc). Reuses the vanilla Firebolt expert projectile (0x10FBEA) + casting art (0x01B211) so the bolt is VISIBLE and delivers the hit — both verified in examples/customspell_spec.json.

spells.name: Ember Lance
spells._: Wraps the custom MGEF at magnitude 25. equipType=EitherHand (Skyrim.esm:0x013F44) so it equips into a hand. baseCost 0 = engine autocalc.

books.name: Spell Tome: Ember Lance
books.text: The teachings of fire, bound in tome. Reading this grants the Ember Lance spell.
books._: THE killer combo: this tome teaches our IN-SPEC custom spell MF_EmberLanceSpell (SPEL FormLink wired in pass 2). Clones the vanilla Destruction spell-tome model from SpellTomeIncinerate (0x10F7F4) so it has a 3D mesh + sounds. CantBeTaken is a vanilla spell-tome flag.

books.name: Spell Tome: Firebolt (copy)
books._: A tome teaching a VANILLA spell (Firebolt, Skyrim.esm:0x012FD0) by external ref — proves teaches.spell works for vanilla SPEL too. Clones the SpellTomeIncinerate model.

books.name: Pyromancy for Beginners
books.text: A primer on the destructive arts. Reading it sharpens your Destruction.
books._: A SKILL book: raises the reader's Destruction skill once on read. teaches.skill is a Skill name (inline, no FormLink). Clones a plain readable book (Book1CheapNordsArise, 0x0ED161) for its model.

books.name: A Torn Note
books._: A plain book — no `teaches`, so Book.Teaches stays BookTeachesNothing. Still needs a model template.
